mentions.name: Toddler-friendly family video conferencing app
mentions.description: A video conferencing app that lets a 2-year-old click on a family member's face to start a call, built with WebRTC, STUN, and browser audio/video capture, featuring automatic bandwidth adjustments and working on all platforms with pure HTML/JS.
mentions.source_excerpt: - video conferencing app that allows a 2 year to click on a family member face and initiates a video conference using webRTC, STUN, and browser audio/video capture with automatic bandwidth adjustments (works on all platforms with pure HTML/JS).

evidence.value: - video conferencing app that allows a 2 year to click on a family member face and initiates a video conference using webRTC, STUN, and browser audio/video capture with automatic bandwidth adjustments (works on all platforms with pure HTML/JS).
